$comment: Lockstep table for the product-bundled built-in hook registry.
The registry is declared TWICE — `lib/claude/hooks/builtin-hooks.ts` (used by
the settings UI, the mobile read-only list and the CLI) and
`src-tauri/src/hooks/builtin.rs` (used by the desktop's host-side merge). They
are hand-maintained and nothing enforced that they agreed, so a hook added or
an id renamed on one side silently changed behaviour on only one shell — and
`builtinHookOverrides` is keyed by id, so a drifted id also orphans a user's
Both sides assert against this table in their own test suite, so a drift fails
on whichever side changed without updating it.
`description` is deliberately absent: it is a UI string that lives in the TS
registry only (the Rust side never renders it), so requiring parity on it
